Measured since filing · 2026-11-02T09:39Z

The premise "a signature line above `Fixes #n` would break the PR-body shape the guards read" did not hold on two PRs. On PR #29100 (`Part of #28914`) and PR #29162 (`Fixes #29023`), the dev issue_patched its own PR body after round 2. The seat signature was line 1, then the attribution block, then the closing keyword. The relay accepted both edits, the bytes read back identical, and Check Changeset, the PR-body guards and `check-partof-closing-keyword` stayed green. So a working door exists today: the dev patches its own body with the seat signature as line 1. What this card still wants is for that to be written down (os-dev.md and the standard orders) rather than discovered per thread, or a cleaner carrier for the signature.

It sends `issue_patch` through `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` with the whole body, ending in `<!-- signed: LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION -->` on the last line. The trailer passes only when the platform reads the target as a pull request. This was measured live on PR #29225's own body, where the platform kept the trailer and the read-back was identical. Teaching the door in the pm-dispatch skill is filed as #29285 (`domain:skills`). `pm:dispatched` is removed in this stroke.
